contentSpacing.description: Page content spacing. Descendant pages inherit this value.

oneOf.title: Compact
oneOf.description: Use restrained spacing between sections and structured blocks.

oneOf.title: Spacious
oneOf.description: Use more expansive spacing between sections and structured blocks.

contentSpacing.markdownDescription:
```yaml
layout:
  contentSpacing: compact
```

Page content spacing. Descendant pages inherit this value.

[Read the relevant reference](https://github.com/janga/norna/blob/v0.7.21/docs/theme.md#page-themes)

textWidth.description: Body-text line length. Descendant pages inherit this value.

oneOf.title: Narrow
oneOf.description: Use a shorter line length suited to reading-focused text.

oneOf.title: Normal
oneOf.description: Use the balanced default line length.

oneOf.title: Wide
oneOf.description: Allow body text to use more horizontal space.

textWidth.markdownDescription:
```yaml
layout:
  textWidth: narrow
```

Body-text line length. Descendant pages inherit this value.

[Read the relevant reference](https://github.com/janga/norna/blob/v0.7.21/docs/theme.md#page-themes)

layout.description: Page-local layout settings inherited by descendant pages.
layout.markdownDescription:
```yaml
layout:
  textWidth: narrow
  contentSpacing: compact
```

Adjusts body-text line length and vertical content spacing for pages below this directory.

[Page theme reference](https://github.com/janga/norna/blob/v0.7.21/docs/theme.md#page-themes)

width.description: Maximum managed-image width. Omit this to keep the selected preset.
width.markdownDescription:
```yaml
images:
  width: 900px
```

Maximum managed-image width. Omit this to keep the selected preset.

[Read the relevant reference](https://github.com/janga/norna/blob/v0.7.21/docs/theme.md#image-sizing)

maxAvailableWidthPercent.description: Maximum percentage of available horizontal space used by managed images.

desktop.markdownDescription:
```yaml

  maxAvailableWidthPercent:
    desktop: 100
```

Percentage used on wider screens.

[Read the relevant reference](https://github.com/janga/norna/blob/v0.7.21/docs/theme.md#image-sizing)

mobile.markdownDescription:
```yaml
images:
  maxAvailableWidthPercent:
    mobile: 100
```

Percentage used on narrow screens.

[Read the relevant reference](https://github.com/janga/norna/blob/v0.7.21/docs/theme.md#image-sizing)

maxAvailableWidthPercent.markdownDescription:
```yaml
images:
  maxAvailableWidthPercent:
    desktop: 100
    mobile: 100
```

Maximum percentage of available horizontal space used by managed images.

[Read the relevant reference](https://github.com/janga/norna/blob/v0.7.21/docs/theme.md#image-sizing)

desktop.markdownDescription:
```yaml

    desktop: 74
```

Percentage used on wider screens.

[Read the relevant reference](https://github.com/janga/norna/blob/v0.7.21/docs/theme.md#image-sizing)

mobile.markdownDescription:

maxAvailableHeightPercent.markdownDescription:

images.description: Optional defaults for managed image presentation.
images.markdownDescription:
```yaml
images:
  width: 900px
```

Adjusts managed-image sizing for pages below this directory.

[Image sizing reference](https://github.com/janga/norna/blob/v0.7.21/docs/theme.md#image-sizing)

backgroundPattern.description: Section background sequence inherited by descendant pages. Non-uniform patterns are invalid with tree navigation.

oneOf.title: Uniform
oneOf.description: Use the normal page background for every H2 section. Tree navigation requires this pattern.

oneOf.title: Alternating
oneOf.description: Alternate normal and subtly contrasting full-width section backgrounds. Available with sections and top navigation.

oneOf.title: Accented
oneOf.description: Move through base, soft, emphasis and soft full-width section backgrounds before repeating. Available with sections and top navigation.

backgroundPattern.markdownDescription:
```yaml
sections:
  backgroundPattern: alternating
```

Section background sequence inherited by descendant pages. Non-uniform patterns are invalid with tree navigation.

[Read the relevant reference](https://github.com/janga/norna/blob/v0.7.21/docs/theme.md#page-themes)

sections.description: Page-local section presentation inherited by descendant pages.
sections.markdownDescription:
```yaml
sections:
  backgroundPattern: alternating
```

Adjusts the H2 section background pattern for pages below this directory. Alternating and accented create full-width bands but are invalid when navigation resolves to tree.

[Page theme reference](https://github.com/janga/norna/blob/v0.7.21/docs/theme.md#page-themes)

description: Limited page presentation overrides inherited by descendant pages. Site colors, corners, typography, content-block defaults and navigation remain global.
title: Norna page theme
markdownDescription:
```yaml
layout:
  textWidth: narrow
  contentSpacing: compact
```

A limited theme in a page or category directory may adjust only page layout, managed-image sizing and the section background pattern. Descendant pages inherit these values. Tree navigation requires a uniform section background. Site colors, corners, typography, content-block defaults and navigation stay consistent.

[Page theme reference](https://github.com/janga/norna/blob/v0.7.21/docs/theme.md#page-themes)
